renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium Eclipse zodiac-guardian future-promise card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the approved named guardian pair or canonical internal pair, never a third guardian, unseen recipient, human, body clue, shadow, reflection, silhouette, empty seat or personal belonging implying someone else. Use every named guardian's canonical element sheet and preserve identity, relative size/colors, silhouette, clothing, signature props, dark-purple eyes with exactly one large plus one small highlight in each visible eye, and visible chest Stella stars. Pair plus focal promise device covers 55–65% and reads at actual width 80px. Translate future-promise into a reversible two-way action: every map, box, page, panel, cue board, plan strip, agreement sheet, folio, chart, footboard, blueprint, selector, token, peg, clip, cover, stop, latch or lock remains removable, half-set, unlatched, open-ended or internally controlled. Symbols/simple shapes only: no readable text, pseudo-text, handwriting lines, name, number, date, clock face, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Keep every composition distinct in camera, depth axis, dominant silhouette, open negative space, reversible control and partial shadow. Only Aries source action-heart1, Aquarius source blue heart-profile bottle1 and Scorpio canonical tail-heart tip1 are allowed; no other heart or heart-shaped void/light. No deterministic agreement, marriage, reunion, return, disclosure, growth, sacrifice, forgiveness or shared destiny. Follow compositionFamily, artDirection, distinctFrom and visualReviewFocus literally. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor on visible paper texture, rounded plush proportions and deep-purple outlines; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
